newsitem.title: USA: Pentair Q2 hit by strong U.S. dollar.
newsitem.headline: Pentair Q2 hit by strong U.S. dollar.

text.p: Pentair Inc said Wednesday the strength of the U.S. dollar hurt second quarter earnings but was largely offset by better than expected performance at several businesses.
Pentair earlier reported fully diluted earnings per share of $0.47, up from $0.40 a share last year.

"The impact of a soft European economy and strong U.S. dollar continued to affect some of our businesses in the second quarter. However, better-than-expected performance in a number of our North American businesses virtually offset the European market and foreign currency concerns," Winslow Buxton, chairman and chief executive, said in a statement.

Pentair's professional tools and equipment businesses were bolstered by sales of new products and continued distribution gains. Its Enclosures businesses continued strong in the North American markets, partially offsetting the ongoing weakness in European enclosure markets, the company said.
The Water Products businesses were flat compared to second quarter 1996 results.
Pentair is a diversified manufacturer in the electrical and electronic enclosures; professional tools and equipment; and water products markets.
